items.title: Daily Briefing
items.script: Here is your daily briefing. Large language models (LLMs) are neural networks trained on vast text collections to predict and generate text. They use Transformers for context connections and pre-training to learn text prediction. Transformer models are widely used in AI but face challenges with memory and computing costs as they grow larger. Augmented large language models (LLMs) show high accuracy in rare disease diagnosis tests, but their real-world medical usefulness is still unproven. Anthropic's IPO is becoming more important as the AI trade slows and interest rates rise.
